_comment: appId is the Android package id (change it before your first release; it cannot change later without reinstalling). cleartextHosts: extra hosts/IPs that may use plain HTTP (e.g. "192.168.1.20"); see docs/android.md. Run `npm run android:sync` after editing. musicbrainzContact: identifies the app to MusicBrainz in standalone mode (their API rules require a contact URL or email).
